name: Browse a real marketplace with no seeded products
description: Verifies the public marketplace starts empty and only shows genuine approved seller listings.
steps: Open the marketplace home page before any seller has published a listing
Open Search and view all categories
After a seller listing is approved, refresh the marketplace
expected: The initial marketplace shows the no-products message with no mock items; only the newly approved seller listing appears after approval.

name: Passwordless signup requires a profile name
description: Verifies the existing passwordless sign-in flow still requires a name for the Danzo profile.
steps: Open Sign up and leave Full name empty
Confirm Continue with email is disabled
Enter a full name and complete email sign-in
expected: A user cannot continue without a full name, and the saved name appears in Profile.

name: Seller submits a listing with two photos and an alternative number
covers: seller profile and Nigerian phone normalization
description: Verifies sellers must submit two photos, a distinct alternative Nigerian number, and payment proof.
steps: Create a seller profile with a WhatsApp number
Open Sell and enter a product price of 20000 naira
Add one product photo and confirm submission is disabled
Add a second photo and enter a different valid Nigerian phone number
Upload the receipt and submit
expected: The listing is saved as Pending with two stored photos and the alternative contact number; it remains hidden from public search until approval.

name: Product cards show one photo and product details show both
covers: first product photo on listing card
second product photo hidden from cards
both photos visible on product detail page
description: Verifies the secondary photo is only returned and displayed after opening a listing.
steps: Approve a listing containing two photos
View the listing card in the marketplace
Open the product detail page
expected: The card shows only the first photo; the detail page displays both photos.

name: Admin approves listing and buyer contacts the alternative number
description: Verifies product contact uses the listing's alternative phone number.
steps: Unlock Admin and approve a seller listing
Sign in as a buyer and open that product
Select Message on WhatsApp
expected: The WhatsApp link opens using the alternative phone number saved on that product.

name: Delete account removes Danzo profile and associated data
covers: seller listings and uploaded photos deletion
description: Verifies a confirmed account deletion removes the user's Danzo marketplace data and signs them out.
steps: Sign in to an account that has a profile and at least one listing or saved item
Open Profile and select Delete Danzo account
Confirm the permanent deletion
expected: The profile, owned listings and their uploaded files, saved items, notifications and authored reports are deleted; the user is signed out. The AppDeploy identity itself remains available for future sign-in.

name: Report listing and enforce seller ownership
description: Verifies buyer reports are recorded and private contact information is withheld from logged-out visitors.
steps: Sign in as a buyer and submit a report
Open a product while logged out
Attempt to edit a listing owned by another account
expected: The report is queued for review, logged-out visitors see a login-to-contact prompt, and cross-account edits are denied.
